title: LibreOffice Writer can open HTML documents, and an HTML document can bind macros to events of the document as a whole,…
description: LibreOffice Writer versions prior to the fix allow HTML documents to bind macros to document-level events such as opening or closing. These macros were not properly checked by the macro security mechanism and could execute regardless of the macro security level set by the user. The issue is addressed in fixed versions where such macros are subject to the same security checks as other macros.
